description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Shaco's''' basic attacks [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slow]] enemies for 2 seconds while ''Two-Shiv Poison'' is not on cooldown.
description.text: Passive: Shaco's basic attacks slow enemies for 2 seconds while Two-Shiv Poison is not on cooldown.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Shaco''' throws a dagger at the target enemy that deals magic damage, [[File:Successfully enhanced damage magic icon.png|20px|link=Damage#Successful_ability_casts]] increased by 50% if they are '''below''' 30% of their '''maximum''' health, and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] them for 3 seconds.
description2.text: Active: Shaco throws a dagger at the target enemy that deals magic damage, increased by 50% if they are below 30% of their maximum health, and slows them for 3 seconds.

description3.raw: '''[[File:Shaco Backstab.png|20xpx|border|link=Shaco#Backstab|An icon for Shaco's ability Backstab]] [[Shaco#Backstab|Backstab]] Bonus:''' The dagger deals an additional 15 – 54.12 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 10% AP) '''bonus''' magic damage, increased to 22.5 – 81.18 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 15% AP) if the target is '''below''' 30% of their '''maximum''' health.
description3.text: Backstab Bonus: The dagger deals an additional 15 – 54.12 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 10% AP) bonus magic damage, increased to 22.5 – 81.18 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 15% AP) if the target is below 30% of their maximum health.

notes.raw: * '''Shaco''' replicates the last attack animation he performed for ''Two-Shiv Poison's'' animation. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
Shaco replicates the last attack animation he performed for Two-Shiv Poison's animation.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
